description: Lists all Mobiscroll Connect REST API endpoints (method, path, summary, auth): OAuth (authorize, token, connection status, disconnect, revoke), calendars, events, webhook subscriptions and the webhook public keys. Also lists "webhook-delivery" (kind "webhook-delivery"): not an endpoint you call but the signed request Connect sends to your webhook URL. Returns the conventions that hold for every endpoint (401 and error body shapes, rate limits). Use getConnectEndpointSchema for full parameter/response detail of one endpoint, getConnectModel for body shapes and getConnectGuide for concepts.
name: listConnectEndpoints
title: List Connect REST Endpoints
